title: Club Membership: employer-linked discount on the reactivation fee
content:
## Scope
This document states, for the Club Membership reactivation payment, the basis on which an employer-linked benefit reduces the reactivation fee portion of the amount collected.

## Rule
Where the member is also the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, that linked employer partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same partnership tier's own multi-location discount percentage, reduces the reactivation fee portion of the amount collected, by that combined percentage. This reduction applies only to the reactivation fee portion; it never reduces the underlying current dues balance the member must also pay.

## Condition table
| Member's corporate wellness enrollment | Reduction applied to the reactivation fee portion |
|---|---|
| Linked and active | Employer partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same tier's own multi-location discount percentage |
| Linked but not active | None |
| No linked enrollment | None |

## Points of judgement
A member with an active linked corporate wellness enrollment still owes the full current dues balance in every case; only the tier's own reactivation fee is ever reduced by this basis, and the reduction never carries over to reduce the dues balance itself.
